mapper.select: SELECT MOCK_ACCOUNT_ID AS mockAccountId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, FINTECH_USE_NUM AS fintechUseNum, BANK_CODE AS bankCode, BANK_NAME AS bankName, ACCOUNT_NO AS accountNo, HOLDER_NAME AS holderName, BALANCE_AMT AS balanceAmt, ACCOUNT_STATE AS accountState FROM MOCK_BANK_ACCOUNT WHERE BANK_NAME = #{bankName} AND ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo} AND ACCOUNT_STATE = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: MERGE INTO MOCK_BANK_ACCOUNT t USING ( SELECT #{bankName} AS BANK_NAME, #{accountNo} AS ACCOUNT_NO FROM DUAL ) s ON (t.BANK_NAME = s.BANK_NAME AND t.ACCOUNT_NO = s.ACCOUNT_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.MEMBER_ID = NVL(#{memberId}, t.MEMBER_ID), t.HOLDER_NAME = #{holderName}, t.BALANCE_AMT = #{balanceAmt}, t.SOURCE_TYPE = #{sourceType}, t.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( MOCK_ACCOUNT_ID, MEMBER_ID, FINTECH_USE_NUM, BANK_CODE, BANK_NAME, ACCOUNT_NO, HOLDER_NAME, BALANCE_AMT, SOURCE_TYPE, ACCOUNT_STATE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MOCK_BANK_ACCOUNT.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{fintechUseNum}, #{bankCode}, #{bankName}, #{accountNo}, #{holderName}, #{balanceAmt}, #{sourceType}, 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
UPDATE MOCK_BANK_ACCOUNT SET BALANCE_AMT = BALANCE_AMT + #{deltaAmount}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE FINTECH_USE_NUM = #{fintechUseNum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MOCK_BANK_TRANSACTION ( TRAN_ID, BANK_TRAN_ID, FINTECH_USE_NUM, INOUT_TYPE, TRAN_AMT, AFTER_BALANCE_AMT, COUNTERPARTY_NAME, COUNTERPARTY_ACCT, PRINT_CONTENT, GROUP_ID, PAYMENT_PROOF_ID, TRAN_DATE, TRAN_TIME, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MOCK_BANK_TX.NEXTVAL, #{bankTranId}, #{fintechUseNum}, #{inoutType}, #{tranAmt}, #{afterBalanceAmt}, #{counterpartyName}, #{counterpartyAcct}, #{printContent}, #{groupId}, #{paymentProofId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT GYE_ACCOUNT_ID AS gyeAccountId, GROUP_ID AS groupId, BANK_NAME AS bankName, HOLDER_NAME_ENC AS holderNameEnc, ACCOUNT_NO_ENC AS accountNoEnc, ACCOUNT_NO_LAST4 AS accountNoLast4, ACCOUNT_NO_HASH AS accountNoHash, KEY_VER AS keyVer, VERIFY_STATUS AS verifyStatus, ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus FROM GYE_ACCOUNT WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'CURRENT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENT_PROOF ( PAYMENT_PROOF_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, PAY_MONTH, ROUND_NO, AMOUNT, PAY_DATE, STATUS, RESUBMIT_COUNT, REVIEW_MEMO, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( NVL((SELECT MAX(PAYMENT_PROOF_ID) FROM PAYMENT_PROOF), 0) + 1, #{groupId}, #{memberId}, #{payMonth}, #{roundNo}, #{amount}, SYSDATE, 'PENDING', 0, #{reviewMemo}, SYSDATE )
